Using real-life inspiration and his vivid imagination, author Charles Dickens brings Ebenezer Scrooge, Tiny Tim and other classic characters to life in A Christmas Carol, forever changing the holiday season into the celebration known today.
Magical Nanny McPhee helps a harried mother who is trying to care for five children and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war.
Five brief encounters occur in five taxis on the same night in Los Angeles, New York, Rome, Paris and Helsinki.
Family members (Pat McNamara, Anne Meara) join a woman (Hope Davis) on an odyssey to confront her husband about a love letter addressed to him.
Private eye Sam Spade (Humphrey Bogart) encounters sundry characters (Mary Astor, Peter Lorre), all seeking a coveted statuette.

Living a bleak existence at a London orphanage, 12-year-old Peter finds himself whisked away to the fantastical world of Neverland. With the turn of events, soon he has to save Neverland from the pirate Blackbeard.

Former special-operations mercenary Frank Martin (Ed Skrein) utilizes his covert skills when a femme fatale (Loan Chabanol) uses him as a pawn in her vengeful scheme against the human trafficker (Camille Delamarre) who victimized her years earlier.
Partnered with a mysterious stranger (Dave Franco), a high school senior (Emma Roberts) joins a popular online game that dares players to perform increasingly dangerous stunts.

After a 50-year-old woman's (Frances McDormand) daughter is murdered, she confronts the police (Caleb Landry Jones, Kerry Condon) in her town, using the billboards on the outskirts of town to begin a smear campaign against them.
A fast-talking literary agent (Eddie Murphy) must learn how to live without speech upon discovering that he has only a thousand words left to say before he dies.
When his boss (John Tormey) turns against him, a hit man (Forest Whitaker) who lives like a samurai must fend for his life.
In the 1870s a Westerner is caught in the middle of a battle between Japan's emperor and the samurai.
After the freighter they're on sinks in a storm, a teenager (Suraj Sharma) and a Bengal tiger wind up on a small lifeboat and must learn to trust each other to survive.

In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman.
A scientist (Patrick McGoohan) sends a "scanner" (Stephen Lack) to hunt others like him with explosive psychic powers.
Agent Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) comes to Twin Peaks, Wash., following two unresolved murders and the disappearance of two fellow agents.
A boy (Wil Wheaton) and his three buddies set out in the summer of 1959 on a hike to find a dead body.

A decade-long restoration comes full circle. This rare, two-tone, Hemi 'Cuda is finally complete and ready to go home, but not before Mark shows us why the Hemi is the King-Kong of the street!
The Graveyard Ghouls are back again! Join Mark Worman and team as they bring you more history, more tech and more Mopar insight than ever before.

Mark fulfills a lifelong dream for a special family when he recreates a 50-year-old, long-lost friend, an A4 Buff Silver 1969 Road Runner convertible with a modern 392 Hemi drivetrain. And three generations arrive to welcome this family friend home.

Mark and Aaron show off two related and rare builds; digging into the Graveyard Carz archives, for the first time ever, they squeeze two complete car builds into one episode, a 1967 Hemi GTX convertible and a 1969 Hemi Road Runner convertible.
Mark airs the entire "Mopar by Death" animated series!
Mark Worman and his skilled staff of mechanics, welders, and painters bring classic 1960s and 1970s Mopar muscle cars back from the dead to look exactly like they did on the showroom floor.
In the south, it's all about family; two brothers ask Tommy to preserve and modernize their grandfather's 1955 Chevy pickup truck, so the team restores this vintage ride to its former glory.
Tommy and his best friend take a ride back to the '80s; the shop crew transforms a bone-stock 1986 Monte Carlo SS into a LT4 "Monster Carlo" mega machine.

Tommy Pike and his crew are no strangers to working on off-road vehicles, so when a client drops off a '74 Bronco, it's game on; they transform this Bronco by dropping a giant engine into a new body, with fresh paint and a fully re-designed interior.
Freiburger and Finnegan take a big-block 1980 Dodge Mirada on a road trip to the site of the Street Machine Nationals in Du Quoin, Ill.

A customer wants FantomWorks to swap out his 1968 Mustang convertible's V6 with the V8 from a donor car, but the exchange is easier said than done; Dan attempts to transform a troublesome 1962 Citroën into a reliable ride.
A client wants Dan to tame a speedy 1969 Pontiac Firebird that is incompatible with his son's disability; Dan works on a 1974 International Harvester Scout that received a 4-year paint job.

When Bobby Cohen spots a rusty British Cab at the junkyard, he vows to do what he can to save it; his son, Andy, thinks he's crazy and makes a big investment in a high dollar Lamborghini Murcielago to recoup the money he worries Bobby will lose.
When Tim's son wants a bigger truck, Andy and Bobby happily hook him up; it'll take a lot to turn a wrecked K-9 explosives police wagon into a camo-wrapped hunting truck.
Martin Bros. Customs prepares to transform a 1970 Chevy C10 into an autocross hot rod; Shag and Amanda desperately search for a sturdy cab for the build.

Three best friends form a pop punk band and compete against rivals in the last Vans Warped Tour. While competing, they discover that the road to fame isn't easy between work, school and relationships.
A lonely girl tries to protect a valuable white lion cub from the poachers who kidnapped it and will stop at nothing to get it back.
A group of talking dogs team up to save the Youth World Cup soccer finals.
Yellowbird (Seth Green), a tiny orphaned bird that has never left the nest, suddenly finds himself leading a flock on its migration to Africa.
A martial artist faces a deadly challenge when a boy claiming to be his brother is kidnapped by evil agents.
Doused with paint, a sparrow's colors change dramatically, leading to a case of mistaken identity.

Disguised as a man, Mulan takes her father's place in the army and becomes a skilled soldier. When she discovers a conspiracy against her country, she sets out to save her people and fight for her family's honor.
After waking up chained together, Zork and Pinky wander across the barren landscape in search of answers.

When poachers steal dozens of egg sacks from his reef, bamboo shark Pup makes it his personal mission to save his unhatched brothers and sisters. His rescue mission takes him above water into the world of man.
A young dolphin with an active imagination discovers a magic arch that makes wishes come true. However, when its enemies use the arch to become big and strong, it must find a way to stop them.

A little boy survives a plane crash and is rescued by a young wild dolphin. They grow up together, entertaining marine life with their funny tricks. One day, the peace of their joyful world is destroyed by an evil octopus.
Following the unexpected success of their debut album, members of the musical group Fisherman's Friends struggle with the pressures, pitfalls and temptations of their newfound fame.
A brother and sister befriend a badly sunburned dolphin that has been separated from its family, uncovering a secret plan that could destroy the beach and their new friend's home.
The kids are thrilled that Bernie has come back. But so has their old enemy Winston, who's about to kidnap the talented dolphin. Kevin and Holly must rescue their splashy friend before it's too late.

p.t: The Lost Colony of Roanoke: New Evidence
p.d: Experts use the latest forensic archaeology to investigate the true story behind the disappearance of more than 100 English colonists who settled on Roanoke Island in 1587.

The Roanoke colony vanishes without a trace, and centuries later, it remains one of history's greatest unsolved mysteries; but new evidence might at last reveal its fate; after a man is swallowed by earth, experts wonder if a sinkhole is to blame.

The sprawling city of Persepolis was capital to the first imperial civilization that conquered most of the known ancient world; experts use advanced forensic archaeology to reveal the secrets behind Persia's mysterious and dominating metropolis.

Venice was once a fearsome superpower home to secrets, wealth, and treachery; today, scientists use pioneering acoustic imaging technology to discover the city's ancient foundations and reveal how it's still standing.

Surrounded by a mysterious trench, only one Egyptian pyramid was ever constructed to look like it floats on water; experts decode the ancient secrets of the pharaoh that are locked inside its hidden tunnels.
Evidence of alien technology around a distant star; speculation about Pluto's surface; Apollo astronauts are at a loss of words to describe an object they encountered while they approached the moon.

After NASA's New Horizons spacecraft flies by Pluto, it encounters a strange alien world that shuts down the probe's computers; experts investigate if the mysterious object is an alien spacecraft hiding at the edge of the solar system.

A strange discovery by NASA's Mars Curiosity rover suggests the Red Planet was home to an alien nuclear war 300 million years ago; experts investigate if an extraterrestrial Armageddon transformed an Earth-like world into a wasteland.
Cosmologists say there are black holes throughout the Universe, but they've never seen one, and it's almost impossible to study them directly.
Spacetime is the secret structure that controls our universe, and this strange four-dimensional substance controls time, light, and energy; it will also determine how our universe will end.

Examine a tiny skeleton in Chile that set off a firestorm of alien speculation; explore a forgotten Silk Road settlement; uncover evidence of a mass sacrifice in northern Peru and visit a multi-faceted military site from the age of the pharaohs.
Experts uncover four global stories of extraordinary curiosities that were once concealed in the deserts of the planet.

Ponder the fate of a mummy buried with an anguished look on its face; learn the secret to Sumerian power in a buried Iraqi palace; visit a lost oasis that may rewrite Arabian history; travel New Mexican roads that align with the heavens.

Look inside the lost tomb of King Thutmose II and get new clues about Egypt's pharaohs; dust off stone hunting structures in Saudi Arabia; visit a 1,200-year-old mosque buried in the Negev Desert and inspect a 30-million-year-old predator skull.

Dig up a mysterious WW II bomber in the Libyan desert, then see why the carved pillars in a Turkish temple may be the world's oldest calendar; open a secret filled shrine in Jerusalem and unearth broken Iraqi bowls that have deep political meaning.

Under the command of Lt. Cdr. Creed Burlingame, the USS Silversides sets its course to patrol in the crossfire of the Guadalcanal campaign to help swing the fighting in America's favor.
The first submarine outfitted with rocket launchers attacks the Japanese coastline.
In April 1944, U-515 heads to the Gold Coast, where it is tested by one of the new Hunter Killer Groups led by Captain Daniel Gallery.
A small fleet of British submarines is perhaps the Allies last chance to keep Germany and the Axis Powers from capturing Egypt.
The February 1945 clash of HMS Venturer and U-864 marks the first underwater submarine battle in history.

p.t: The Battle of Normandy: 85 Days in Hell
p.d: On D-Day, Allied forces land in Normandy, France, to beat back the German troops and liberate France; previously unseen archival footage captures the 85-day struggle to liberate Europe and includes rare images of the battle itself.

Newly restored film footage uncovers the story of the iconic B-17 and its contribution to the victory during World War II, including first-hand tales from veterans and the restoration of the plane for the National Museum of the U.S. Air Force.
Personal accounts of the atomic attack on Hiroshima in 1945; the comprehensive story of the bombing of Hiroshima, from those who built it, dropped it, and survived it.
Footage of the Pacific campaign during World War II and Japan's downfall.
In 1944, the Allied invasion of Nazi-occupied Europe brings the hope of freedom and the devastation of war to the people of France.
New colorized footage and testimony reveal the cost paid by the Allies and civilians to free Belgium and the Netherlands from Nazi occupation.
In late 1944, Hitler forces the Americans into their biggest battle of the war when he launches a surprise attack into liberated Belgium.
New colorized footage and testimony reveals the cost of victory, the aftermath of war and the liberation of the camps and the destruction of Germany.
Rare archive footage charts the German Army in 1940 as it unleashes a new Blitzkrieg tactic.

Anna Strazynska prezentuje wiele kulinarnych inspiracji, praktycznych wskazówek i pomyslów, latwych do wykorzystania w domowej kuchni. Widzowie poznaja kulisy pracy w gastronomii i odkrywaja sekrety dan, które zachwycaja smakiem i estetyka.

Serwis informacyjny, nadawany co pól godziny, przedstawia najwazniejsze biezace wydarzenia.
Pawel znika po wypuszczeniu wszystkich psów ze schroniska i ukrywa sie na wyspie - chce zostac pustelnikiem Pawlem z Wyspy. Tymczasem Auguscik prowadzi brawurowa akcje poszukiwawcza.
W lecznicy pojawia sie rzeznik, który oskarza Sylwie o sfalszowanie dokumentów koni ze stanicy, domagajac sie odszkodowania. Doktor rozmawia z Rychterowa na temat czynszu za wynajem domu.

Jacek i pan Stanislaw jezdza na zmiane stara, zdezelowana taksówka. Kierownictwo MPT obiecuje im jednak wkrótce wymiane wysluzonego wozu na nowy. Z kolei studiujacy w stolicy Taj o imieniu Krashan Bhamaradzanga ma klopoty z wierzycielami.

Zaproszeni do programu dziennikarze zadaja pytania gosciom ze swiata polityki, sztuki czy biznesu.

Urzednicy we wsi Polskie Pole zmagaja sie z problemami mieszkanców i wlasnymi sprawami prywatnymi. Wójt Eligiusz Czapla walczy o uzyskanie praw miejskich dla Polskiego Pola, skupiony na rozwoju swojej malej ojczyzny.

Daniel rozpoczyna wspólprace z redakcja Szoku, a opieka Weroniki nad nowym pracownikiem budzi zazdrosc Modrzyckiego. Tymczasem utrata przez Agate kluczowych zdjec dla ubezpieczyciela stawia pod znakiem zapytania odszkodowanie dla Huberta.
Pandore suit le duel entre un politicien opportuniste et une juge d'instruction dévouée à la recherche de la vérité à la suite du viol d'une jeune femme.

Claire, pour se racheter de sa faute familiale, s'implique démesurément dans l'affaire du viol collectif d'une activiste, Ludivine, dont une vidéo circule sur le Web ; un seul violeur y apparait : Wahab, jeune Marocain en séjour illégal.
Ce rendez-vous réveil-matin propose de faire un point sur l'actualité, assorti de différentes rubriques permettant d'explorer certains aspects plus en profondeur.
La commandante Anne Capestan, une policière déchue, est mise à la tête d'une équipe plutôt spéciale.
